title: Walking Time Calculator: Duration from Distance
description: Convert walking distance into duration at your chosen speed with the Walking Time Calculator — honest estimates for real walks. Free.
summary_sentence: For example, 6 miles at a textbook 3 mph is exactly 2 hours — the estimate every other walker on the path is silently using too.
quick_answer: The Walking Time Calculator converts a walking distance into a duration at the speed you choose. Set places or enter the distance, pick the pace that matches the walker, and read the time — the simple division that turns 'a few miles' into a plan with a clock on it.

faq: The calculator takes the speed you set — set a hill speed for a hill walk. For climb priced into the estimate itself, the Hiking Time Calculator applies Naismith's rule.
Does the route include live traffic?
No. Crossings cost seconds that live inside a realistic average; the division itself is traffic-free.
Why is road distance longer than straight-line?
Enter the walking distance — from the pedestrian route, not the crow. Time belongs to the ground covered.
Can route results change over time?
Your speed changes with fitness, load and company. Recompute with the current walker.

Groups move at the slowest member plus conversation. Set the speed to the party's measured one — the calculator forgives; the sunset does not.
